content: Almost four decades after the film’s release, filmmakers David Fincher and Tim Miller attempted to reboot Heavy Metal, which eventually morphed into the Netflix sci-fi anthology, Love, Death & Robots. Although the series inevitably carries the DNA of Heavy Metal and its contemporaries, Love, Death & Robots carves out its distinct identity over 45 exceptional episodes. While sci-fi is at the heart of these anthology tales, the show blends everything from horror to comedy to complement the bountiful art styles that are a celebration of animation as a medium.
